name: Godrej Lake Gardens
why_worth_considering: Direct unhindered frontage on Kaikondrahalli Lake. ~₹2,400/sqft cheaper than Bellandur Core while offering Tier 1 Godrej construction, Olympic swimming pool, and high greenery.
key_tradeoffs_complaints: Sarjapur Road peak hour bottleneck near Carmelaram railway gate. Extra 12-18 min commute to Ecospace during evening rush.
water_source: Dual (Cauvery pipeline active + Deep Borewells + STP)

name: Brigade Cornerstone Utopia
why_worth_considering: Massive 47-acre integrated smart township with high-street retail, cineplex, school, and commercial offices inside the campus. Exceptional value per sqft (< ₹10k/sqft) for a Tier 1 developer.
key_tradeoffs_complaints: Varthur Road widening is incomplete in certain segments; transit through Gunjur junction slows down during school hours.
water_source: Treated Rainwater Reservoirs + Borewells (Cauvery phase 2 expected)

name: Purva Fairmont
why_worth_considering: Located in Bengaluru's most sought-after planned residential sector (HSR Layout). Tree-lined 80ft sector avenues, top eateries, elite schools, zero industrial dust.
key_tradeoffs_complaints: Higher entry pricing (~₹15.8k/sqft). Agara junction signal wait during peak morning hours when exiting onto ORR.

name: Purva Riviera
why_worth_considering: Prime frontage on ORR north of Kadubeesanahalli. Huge open grounds, large Olympic pool, mature community, walking distance to Multiplexes and retail.
key_tradeoffs_complaints: 11-year old society requiring periodic facade painting. Traffic noise and dust from Marathahalli flyover junction.

name: SJR Palazza City
why_worth_considering: Very affordable entry ticket (< ₹1.5 Cr for 2.5 BHK) in a modern high-rise close to HSR and Bellandur. Complete clubhouse amenities and tennis court.
key_tradeoffs_complaints: Harlur main road has high vehicular density with narrow sections; water tanker dependency during peak summer months.
water_source: Borewells + Water Tankers (Cauvery connection application in process)

name: Prestige Lakeside Habitat
why_worth_considering: 102-acre sprawling mega-township overlooking Varthur Lake. Disney-themed landscaping, 4 mega clubhouses, skating rinks, cricket pitch. High resale liquidity.
key_tradeoffs_complaints: Varthur lake rejuvenation work causes occasional odor during windy evenings; 7 km distance from Bellandur tech parks.
water_source: Dual (In-house Water Treatment Plant + High-capacity Borewells)
